item.description: ### Fixed - **Your phone and watch stay paired when the Keychain is locked.** If Perch couldn't read its pairing key — a locked keychain, or a Keychain prompt that was dismissed — it quietly made a new one, and every paired device stopped connecting with no explanation. It now waits and tries again, and Settings says what's wrong and how to fix it. - **Codex spend is no longer overstated when you switch models.** Changing model partway through a Codex session re-priced everything the session had already done at the new rate, and long turns could make it count the same work again. Each part of a session is now priced once, at the model that did it.
